name: Nagaremono no Komoriuta
source:
Main character Joan leads a troupe of traveling performers. After sudden death of previous leader things have gone downhill, so now hero needs to refine skills of each troupe member to make as much money as possible. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公乔安领导着一个巡回表演剧团。前任团长突然去世后情况急转直下，现在主人公需要提升每位团员的技能，尽可能多地赚取收入。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
